items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 1:1
items.html: The Hesed of Atik that is clothed in the first three of the Galgalta is called Avir dakia. This is because the Galgalta is corrected in the aspect of a ring, which is the MEM of Tzelem, so that no power of screen and restriction can rule over it; hence it is called dakia, meaning clean of all restriction. And since it is in the aspect of Hassadim, it is therefore called air (Avir), for air means the light of spirit, which is Hassadim. See Answer 69. (Part 1, Page 321, Item 62).
